description: This file defines data structures and functions for exporting message, post, and channel data in Mattermost, including handling of file uploads, edits, deletions, and user join/leave events.

classes.name: PostExport
classes.description: Represents an exported post with metadata, including message content, user type, edit/delete status, and attachments.

classes.name: FileUploadStartExport
classes.description: Represents the start of a file upload in the export, including user email, start time, and file info.

classes.name: FileUploadStopExport
classes.description: Represents the end of a file upload, including user email, stop time, status, and file info.

classes.name: ChannelExport
classes.description: Contains exported data for a channel, including posts, files, join/leave events, and metadata.

classes.name: JoinExport
classes.description: Represents a user joining a channel during export period.

classes.name: LeaveExport
classes.description: Represents a user leaving a channel during export period.

classes.name: GenericExportData
classes.description: Aggregates all exported channel data, metadata, and results.

methods.name: GetGenericExportData
methods.description: Assembles all data into a generic export format, processing posts, attachments, and user activity.

methods.name: postToAttachmentsEntries
methods.description: Processes post attachments, returning uploaded files, start/stop uploads, and deleted file messages.

methods.name: getPostExport
methods.description: Determines the type of post (created, edited, deleted, updated) and returns corresponding export entry.

methods.name: getJoinsAndLeaves
methods.description: Generates join and leave events for users in a channel within a time period.

methods.name: createdPostToExportEntry
methods.description: Creates export entry for a newly created post.

methods.name: deletedPostToExportEntry
methods.description: Creates export entry for a deleted post.

methods.name: editedOriginalMsgToExportEntry
methods.description: Creates export entry for an original message that was edited.

methods.name: editedNewMsgToExportEntry
methods.description: Creates export entry for a post that was edited to a new message.

methods.name: updatedPostToExportEntry
methods.description: Creates export entry for an updated post (e.g., reaction).

methods.name: deleteFileToExportEntry
methods.description: Creates export entry for a deleted file attachment.

methods.name: UploadStartToExportEntry
methods.description: Creates export entry for the start of a file upload.
